notes: Direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/bypass needed). Shopify store. Rule 1 confirmed hard: collections.json 'products_count' is heavily inflated on this site (e.g. Vases 101 vs true 18, Artefacts 99 vs true 47, Candle Holders 79 vs true 23, Lighting 42 vs true 3, Trays & Baskets 218 vs true 51) -- every qty below is the exact enumerated /collections/<handle>/products.json count, cross-verified against the rendered collection page's own 'N products' text and/or its Product-type filter facet counts (both matched in every case checked). Where a named collection was a genuine mixed roll-up (per-title/per-facet inspection), the non-qualifying items were dropped rather than padding the count: Artefacts (accent-pieces) 47->44 dropping 3 ashtrays (BAR ACCESSORIES); Candle Holders 23->22 dropping 1 'Artificial Assorted Shell Set' (not a candle holder); Accent Trays 7->5 dropping 2 ashtrays; Planters 64->63 dropping 1 item facet-tagged VASES ('Eden Vase - Large'). Napkin Holders & Rings = 26 NAPKIN HOLDERS + 3 NAPKIN RINGS from /collections/napkin-holder (33 total, dropped 4 TRAYS&BASKETS-type items already out of scope for this row) + 1 NAPKIN RINGS item from the separate /collections/table-napkins collection (dropped its 1 textile napkin set) = 30. CLOCKS: no Clocks collection/nav item exists; site search q=clock returns 27 fuzzy text matches (title-scanned in full) but zero are actual wall/table clocks -- all are 'watch box', 'remote holder', storage racks etc; confirmed absent, not a false-negative search result. MIRRORS: no Mirrors collection exists (only a 0-product 'Vanity Mirrors' placeholder collection and search-suggest hits for decorative mirror TRAYS, not mirrors); confirmed absent. GLASSWARE/true Drinkware: the only 'Drinkware' collection (3 items) is 100% ashtrays (BAR ACCESSORIES type); no glasses/tumblers/stemware found anywhere on site; confirmed absent. EXCLUDED wholesale per scope: Furniture (furniture-lighting incl. coffee/side/c-tables, drinks tables, ottomans), Plants & Planters' artificial-plant/flower lines (faux plants/flowers), Storage & Organisers (kitchen/bathroom/accessory/leather organisers, storage bags, tissue boxes, dustbins), Bath & More (Bathroom Sets, Toilet Brushes, Bathroom Organisers, Bath Mats -- all functional bath fixtures/accessories, not 'genuinely decorative'), Kitchen & Storage Organisers, Kitchen Tools, Cutlery, Cutlery Holders, Table Mats, Table Runners, textile Table Napkins, Bedding (all textile), Festive (Toran, Rangoli, Latkan, Shubh Labh, Votive [all-Diya/festive items on title-scan], Festive Decor, Christmas -- Holiday & Gift), Rugs, Bar Accessories, Games (1 chess set), and Fragrances & Candles (5 items, 4 AROMA/scented + 1 stray decor item, dropped as a fragrance-dominant mixed roll-up). Duplicate-company check: grepped 'masonhome'/'Mason Home' across all previously archived c*.json in this batch (SR 1-293) -- no match found; no duplicate-company determination triggered.
